name: huaweicloud-mate
description: Huawei Cloud agent plugin development package

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-contracts.mjs && node scripts/copy-host-assets.mjs && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && node scripts/create-runtime-manifest.mjs && node scripts/create-install-manifest.mjs
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli.js doctor --contracts-only
scripts.mcp: npm run build && node dist/cli.js mcp
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run source:check && npm test && npm run pack:check && npm run licenses:check && npm run release:check
